description: Library: contracts:organizer-nomenclature reaches rewriteDartDirectives and rewritePathMentions through the rename libraries. The context move is finished: --check reports no legacy file waiting, lib/domain and lib/data are gone, and context_map.json has no moveTo entry. The catch_arch_* lints and audit:context-map enforce placement. Its CLI still prints the plan and --verify proves an old move commit. Moves legacy domain/ and data/ files into lib/contexts/<context>/ as tool/architecture/context_map.json places them, rewrites every Dart directive and whole-path mention, writes each context's public API file, and proves a move commit is mechanical (--verify). --imports-only updates another branch after the move lands.
